transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, what brings me in is that my eating has just gotten really off lately. Some days I barely get down a coffee and maybe a granola bar before a shift. And... well, my scrubs have been hanging pretty loose on me, even though I'm not trying to lose weight at all.
Have you noticed any new symptoms like feeling unusually hot, sweating more than normal, or your heart racing?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I mean, I might sweat a little if I'm rushing around the floor at work, but definitely not more than normal. I haven't felt unusually hot, and my heart hasn't been racing or anything. It's really just the lack of appetite.
Have you been experiencing any heartburn, a burning sensation in your chest, or a sour taste coming up after eating?
No, I haven't had any of that either. No heartburn or burning in my chest... and no sour taste. Just the lack of appetite, like I said.
Do you have any fear of gaining weight, or do you see yourself as heavier than others might say you are?

No, not at all. I don't have any fear of gaining weight. Honestly, I wouldn't mind putting a few pounds back on so my clothes fit right again. And no, I don't think I'm heavy. I know I've lost weight, I just... don't have the drive to eat.
Over the past few weeks, have you noticed feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you normally enjoy?

Yeah, I have. It's... well, most mornings I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling. It just feels like the day is already ruined before I even put on my badge for work. I just don't have much interest in doing much of anything right now.
How long have you been feeling this way—the low mood and decreased appetite—has it been going on for a few days, or more like a couple of weeks or longer?

Well, the low mood and the loss of interest... that's been going on for a while now. It's not just a few days or weeks. It really settled in about a year and four months ago, and it's just been steady since then.

Over this past year and four months, has your mood and energy stayed pretty much the same the whole time, or have there been certain stretches where things got noticeably worse or more intense before returning to this baseline?

It's pretty much stayed the same the whole time. For most of this whole stretch, I’ve been living with that heavy, hollow mood and loss of interest. It hasn't really been a situation where I just have a few bad weeks here and there, and then it gets better. It's just been a constant, steady low for the entire year and four months.
During this past year and four months, have you had any thoughts of death, that you'd be better off dead, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

I haven't made any kind of plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But... yeah, I do catch myself wishing I just wouldn't wake up in the morning. Sometimes I just think it would be a lot easier if I could just disappear. It's just... it's just a thought that crosses my mind when things feel really heavy.
During this past year and four months, have you also noticed trouble sleeping (either sleeping too much or too little), feeling unusually tired or low energy, or trouble concentrating?

Yeah, sleep has been a real problem. I... I just can't seem to get a good night's rest. I'll lie there for a long time, just replaying everything that happened at work, and... I'm always kind of listening for noises, too. It makes it hard to drift off. And then, even when I do fall asleep, I end up waking up around 3 or 4 in the morning. After that, I just can't settle back down before my alarm goes off. So I'm definitely feeling pretty tired and low on energy most days.

Can you tell me more about what you mean by 'replaying everything that happened at work' — is there a specific frightening or distressing event from work that keeps coming back to your mind, like intrusive memories or flashbacks?

No, it's nothing like a flashback or one big scary event. It's just... normal work stuff. Like, I'll just lay there thinking about a conversation I had with a coworker, or if I did a task right, or if I forgot something. It's just my mind spinning on the day-to-day things, nothing traumatic.
Over this same period, have you noticed trouble concentrating or making decisions, like difficulty focusing on tasks at work or trouble making even simple choices?

No, I haven't really noticed any issues with that. I mean, even with being as tired as I am from not sleeping, I can still focus on my work just fine. And making decisions... no, that hasn't been a problem either. I can still figure out what I need to do and just get it done.
